Classic Comfort in the Heart of Venice
Located in the heart of central Venice, Hotel Castello is the ideal solution for those looking for a 3-star hotel near St. Mark’s in a strategic and authentic location. Just a few minutes’ walk from St.Mark’s Square, the Arsenale, and the Biennale Gardens, the hotel offers the perfect balance between centrality, tranquility, and comfort.
If you wish to stay near St. Mark’s without giving up the charm of a historic Venetian palace, Hotel Castello represents a quality choice in the heart of the city. Housed in a 17th-century building, this 3-star hotel near St. Mark’s welcomes guests in refined rooms, furnished in authentic Venetian style with wood paneling, fine damasks, and splendid Murano glass chandeliers.
Thanks to its privileged location in central Venice, the hotel allows easy access to the main
attractions of the city, vaporetto stops, and the most picturesque areas of the lagoon. The reception is open 24 hours a day, and common areas include a bright breakfast room and a magnificent panoramic terrace with views over the rooftops of Venice and St. Mark’s Campanile.
Choosing Hotel Castello means booking a 3-star hotel near St. Mark’s, in the heart of central Venice, perfect for couples, families, and travelers who wish to experience an authentic stay, just steps from the wonders of the city.

Locanda Correr
Located in one of the most charming areas of Venice, Locanda Correr collaborates with Hotel Castello in Venice, just a few steps away, which manages guest reception and provides the main hotel services.
Discover Locanda

Services
Hotel Castello provides its guests with a range of services carefully designed to ensure a stay in Venice full of comfort and tranquility.
Among the main services, the hotel provides a breakfast included with sweet and savory buffet, served on the ground floor from 08:00 to 10:00, for a pleasant wake-up in the heart of Venice.
The property also offers a convenient laundry and ironing service, together with a free luggage storage, perfect to enjoy the city without worries both before check-in and after check-out.
In all rooms and common areas, free Wi-Fi connection is available, to stay always connected during the stay.
Guests can access the splendid panoramic terrace on the third floor, open from 07:00 to 23:00: an intimate and suggestive space from which to admire unique views over the rooftops of Venice and let themselves be conquered by the magic of the city.
Small dogs are allowed free of charge upon request.
Breakfast
Breakfast is served in the breakfast room on the ground floor from 8:00 to 10:00 and offers a buffet with sweet, savory, and gluten-free options to meet every need. It includes hot drinks from the traditional Italian coffee bar to start the day in the best way.
Terrace
On the third floor of the hotel is a charming panoramic terrace, from which you can admire the domes of St. Mark’s, the Campanile, and the picturesque rooftops of Venice.
A bright and peaceful space, ideal for reading or simply relaxing, enjoying a unique view over the lagoon city.
Verde Bistro
Verde Bistro, historic Venetian venue, has always shared with us the passion for Venice. Just a few steps from the property, we consider this venue part of our family. From typical Venetian cicchetti to pinsa, from cocktails to filled sandwiches, they have always welcomed the staff and our guests in an intimate environment guaranteeing the possibility to enjoy a 10% discount.

Rooms Hotelcastello
Skip to content
Rooms
Bright and comfortable, the 26 rooms of the property reflect the unmistakable Venetian style,
enhanced by refined Murano glass chandeliers and elegant Rubelli damask wallpapers, which give
warmth and a timeless atmosphere.
Each room is equipped with TV, telephone, minibar, safe, and air conditioning, to ensure maximum comfort during the stay. Each room has a private bathroom with bathtub or shower, complete with a convenient hairdryer and courtesy kit.
A perfect balance between Venetian tradition and modern comforts, ideal to experience Venice with style and relaxation.
Some rooms offer a suggestive view of St. Mark’s Campanile and the domes of St. Mark’s Basilica.
Double room
A cozy retreat in the heart of Venice, the double room combines modern comfort with Venetian atmosphere. Decorated in a classic style, it offers a warm and relaxing environment, perfect for
resting after a day spent exploring the city’s narrow streets, museums, and canals.
The room features a double bed, private bathroom with shower or bathtub, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, TV, telephone, minibar, and safe, ensuring a practical and comfortable stay in any season.
Ideal for couples, friends, or families seeking tranquility and convenience amidst the timeless charm of the city.
Book now
Twin Room
Set in the evocative Venetian context, the twin room offers a comfortable and well-organized space, designed to ensure both relaxation and functionality. The classic furnishings create a pleasant and peaceful atmosphere, perfect for recharging after a day of sightseeing.
The room includes two single beds, private bathroom with shower, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, TV,telephone, minibar, and safe, providing all the necessary comforts for a practical stay at any time of the year.
Perfect for friends or travelers who want comfort and serenity while experiencing the authentic
charm of Venice.
Book now
Triple Room
Spacious and welcoming, the triple room is ideal for those traveling in company without sacrificing comfort. The classic Venetian furnishings and relaxing atmosphere make it perfect for arejuvenating break after a day exploring the city’s attractions.
The room features a double bed and single bed or three single beds, private bathroom with shower or bathtub, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, TV, telephone, minibar, and safe, ensuring a comfortable and functional stay in any season.
Ideal for families or friends, it offers the right space to share the unique experience of Venice intotal tranquility.
Book now
Quadruple Room
Spacious and comfortable, the quadruple room is perfect for those traveling in a group without compromising on comfort. The classic Venetian furnishings and relaxing atmosphere make it ideal for a restorative break after a day visiting the city’s wonders.
The room includes a double bed and two single beds or four single beds, private bathroom with bathtub or shower, air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, TV, telephone, minibar, and safe, ensuring a comfortable and functional stay in any season.
Ideal for families or friends, it offers the perfect space to share the unique experience of Venice in complete relaxation.

Location Hotelcastello

Location
How to reach us
Even if directions lead you off course and you end up taking a longer route, we like to recall what a famous poet once wrote:
« Wandering through calli and campi without a fixed itinerary is perhaps the greatest pleasure one can enjoy in Venice. Blessed are those poor in topography, blessed are those who do not know what they are doing—that is, where they are going—for to them is reserved the kingdom of all surprises… »
Diego Valeri, Sentimental Guide to Venice.
By plane
From Venice “Marco Polo” Airport: take the Alilaguna Blue Line waterbus and get off at the San Zaccaria stop after approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes. From there, walk along Calle delle Rasse to Campo SS. Filippo e Giacomo, where the hotel sign will be on the left.
From Treviso “Antonio Canova” Airport: take the ATVO Treviso Airport Bus Express and get off at Piazzale Roma after approximately 1 hour and 10 minutes. From there, take waterbus number 1 or 5.1 towards Lido and get off at San Zaccaria. Then walk along Calle delle Rasse to Campo SS. Filippo e Giacomo, where the hotel sign will be on the left.
By train
From Venice Santa Lucia railway station, take waterbus number 1 or 5.1 towards Lido and get off at San Zaccaria. Then walk along Calle delle Rasse to Campo SS. Filippo e Giacomo, where the hotel sign will be on the left.
By car
The historic center of Venice is car-free. The most convenient parking is at Piazzale Roma or Tronchetto. From the highways, follow the signs for Venice. At the end of the Ponte della Libertà bridge connecting the city to the mainland, turn right to park at Tronchetto or continue straight to Piazzale Roma. From both terminals, take waterbus number 2 towards Lido and get off at San Zaccaria. Then walk along Calle delle Rasse to Campo SS. Filippo e Giacomo, where the hotel sign will be on the left.
